article.hook: Everyone notices when you stop shrinking. The North Node in Leo pulls the story toward your own name in lights, not just the background noise. Step forward or fade out - there’s no middle ground here.
article.lived: Over the next year and a half, the urge to show up as yourself intensifies in everyday moments. You’ll find yourself volunteering to lead projects, sharing bold opinions in meetings, or picking that one outfit that can’t be ignored. Groups and institutions watch as individuals break from the usual script, demanding space to be celebrated for what they create or stand for, not just what they do quietly.
article.turn: The problem starts when the spotlight becomes a stage for performance, not presence. We push for attention so hard that the moment feels staged - like applause is the goal, not connection. When you chase being seen instead of being real, you end up invisible in plain sight.
moves: Host a live event where you showcase your work or passion.
Speak up first in a meeting with a clear, confident statement.
Wear something this week that feels true to your identity, no apologies.
